record.label: Parallel Grover query model
record.statement: Each round allows up to $m$ simultaneous queries on disjoint registers within a shared quantum state. The registers may be entangled. Cost is the expected number of rounds.
record.boundary: With $n=3$ and $m=2$, one round applies the marking oracle to two four-qubit registers. Putting one target qubit in $|+\rangle$ leaves one active query in that round. A call reached with probability $0.4$ contributes $0.4$ to the expected number of rounds. The cost model charges any unitary whose matrix equals an embedding of the parallel oracle.
